info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Enterprise Services Legal Advisory Engagement-v5-spec
info.description: The Legal Advisory Engagement API facilitates the creation of legal advisory engagements within banking enterprise services. This API enables financial institutions to efficiently manage their legal advisory needs by allowing authorized users to establish new engagements. Typical consumers include legal teams and compliance officers in banks who require streamlined processes to ensure robust legal support. The API supports the creation of structured and detailed engagement records, enabling institutions to improve their legal advisory workflows.

post.summary: Create a new legal advisory engagement.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new engagement with a legal advisory service. Provide the necessary details in the request body to initiate the engagement process. Ensure that all required information is included to avoid validation errors.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating a new legal advisory engagement. This must contain all necessary details regarding the engagement such as client information, scope of work, and any specific requirements.

201.description: The engagement has been successfully created.
